functions.name: Send-DiscordFile
functions.description: Envoie un fichier (pièce jointe) sur Discord.
functions.source:
function Send-DiscordFile {
    param([string]$WebhookUrl, [string]$FilePath, [string]$Content = '')
    if (-not (Test-Path $FilePath)) { throw "File not found: $FilePath" }
    $multipart = @{ payload_json = $Content }
    $file = Get-Item $FilePath
    $boundary = [System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
    $webRequest = [System.Net.WebRequest]::Create($WebhookUrl)
    $webRequest.Method = 'POST'
    $webRequest.ContentType = "multipart/form-data; boundary=$boundary"
    $webRequest.Timeout = 30000
    $utf8 = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8
    $bytes = $utf8.GetBytes("--$boundary`r`nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=`"file`"; filename=`"$($file.Name)`"`r`nContent-Type: application/octet-stream`r`n`r`n")
    $fileBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($FilePath)
    $endBytes = $utf8.GetBytes("`r`n--$boundary--`r`n")
    $webRequest.ContentLength = $bytes.Length + $fileBytes.Length + $endBytes.Length
    $requestStream = $webRequest.GetRequestStream()
    $requestStream.Write($bytes, 0, $bytes.Length)
    $requestStream.Write($fileBytes, 0, $fileBytes.Length)
    $requestStream.Write($endBytes, 0, $endBytes.Length)
    $requestStream.Close()
    $response = $webRequest.GetResponse()
    $responseStream = $response.GetResponseStream()
    $reader = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($responseStream)
    $reader.ReadToEnd() | Out-Null
    $reader.Close()
    $response.Close()
    Write-SysLog "Discord file sent: $($file.Name)" -Level 'INFO'
    return $true
}

functions.name: Send-TelegramDocument
functions.description: Envoie un document (PDF, ZIP, etc.) sur Telegram.
functions.source:
function Send-TelegramDocument {
    param([string]$BotToken, [string]$ChatId, [string]$FilePath, [string]$Caption = '')
    if (-not (Test-Path $FilePath)) { throw "File not found: $FilePath" }
    $url = "https://api.telegram.org/bot$BotToken/sendDocument"
    $boundary = [System.Guid]::NewGuid().ToString()
    $fileBytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes($FilePath)
    $multipart = "--$boundary`r`nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=`"chat_id`"`r`n`r`n$ChatId`r`n--$boundary`r`nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=`"caption`"`r`n`r`n$Caption`r`n--$boundary`r`nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=`"document`"; filename=`"$(Split-Path $FilePath -Leaf)`"`r`nContent-Type: application/octet-stream`r`n`r`n"
    $multipart += [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString($fileBytes)
    $multipart += "`r`n--$boundary--`r`n"
    $headers = @{ 'Content-Type' = "multipart/form-data; boundary=$boundary" }
    $response = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Method Post -Body $multipart -Headers $headers -ErrorAction Stop
    Write-SysLog "Telegram document sent: $(Split-Path $FilePath -Leaf)" -Level 'INFO'
    return $response.ok
}
